# Controller-stage fake95 preparation — 2026-09-14

This source-only instrument derives from the accepted startup81 qualification
(`9c87ec2`) and follows the controller-worker-stage repair brief. It has not
run. No actual admission or run directory is created.

The ordered union is the original 81 cases followed by the frozen 14 stage
controls. All three old test files and the original startup fixture are copied
unchanged. Only `startup_fixture_adapter.py` selects the appended stage source
`2f12cbf5`; its 28,922-byte accepted prefix remains `6482b782`. The canonical
adapter/resolver and current durable lifecycle retain their original pins.

The loader appends `worker_stage_fixture` and
`test_controller_worker_stage`, giving 23 modules and 25 child texts.
No new standard-library preload is required. The original resolver alias
restoration and closed-pair checks remain. Two stage-function captures extend
the original 36; one exact `_DurableKernel` type is captured before test
definitions and checked at completion. The ten-guard receipt shape is unchanged.

The stage author's larger reference map contains protocol/generated/native
context that differs from the startup81 loaded set. Those references are not
substituted here: the existing protocol `437e0880`, generated adapter
`b43ce233` and Win32 connection `b39a29ce` remain exact. SOURCE-INPUTS.json
identifies every selected byte source.

New checks use actual local startup, lease, session, reservation and factory
paths with inert lower services. They establish neither Windows resume nor
assigned-job/read-set ownership, authenticated pipes, completed worker startup
or permission to construct a model. The failed child delivery and its 17 tests
are excluded. Generated39 assertions are preserved outside this union.

The complete before files, exact declared edits and reconstructable qualifier
and launcher diffs are retained. Root and peer review must precede separate
fake-service admission. Real globals and entry refusals remain closed.

param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][ValidatePattern('^[a-z0-9-]+$')][string]$ProofName)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$taskRoot='E:\AI\projects\uoink\checkouts\Yoink-library'
$taskWork='C:\Users\hello\AppData\Local\AgentControlRoom\worktrees\uoink-library\05a3bf93-0b6\gemini'
$taskRel='docs/library/proof/'+$ProofName
$taskPatch=Join-Path $taskRoot ('_scratch/'+$ProofName+'.patch')
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskPatch){throw 'Fresh patch required'}
git -C $taskWork add -N -f -- $taskRel
if($global:LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $global:LASTEXITCODE}
git -C $taskWork diff --binary --full-index -- $taskRel > $taskPatch
if($global:LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $global:LASTEXITCODE}
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false
git -C $taskRoot -c core.autocrlf=false apply --3way --whitespace=nowarn $taskPatch 1> (Join-Path $taskRoot ('_scratch/'+$ProofName+'-apply.stdout.log')) 2> (Join-Path $taskRoot ('_scratch/'+$ProofName+'-apply.stderr.log'))
$taskExit=$global:LASTEXITCODE
[ordered]@{proof=$taskRel;patch=$taskPatch;bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $taskPatch).Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $taskPatch -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();apply_exit=$taskExit} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
exit $taskExit

import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import crypto from 'node:crypto';
const name=process.argv[2],record=process.argv[3];if(!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(name??'')||!/^[A-Z0-9-]+\.json$/.test(record??''))throw Error('Exact proof and fresh result names required');
const root='E:/AI/projects/uoink/checkouts/Yoink-library',work='C:/Users/hello/AppData/Local/AgentControlRoom/worktrees/uoink-library/05a3bf93-0b6/gemini',rel='docs/library/proof/'+name,sha=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),output=path.join(root,'_scratch',record);if(fs.existsSync(output))throw Error('Fresh record required');
const seal=fs.readFileSync(path.join(work,rel,'SHA256.json')),rows=JSON.parse(seal).files,all=[...rows,{path:'SHA256.json',bytes:seal.length,sha256:sha(seal)}],changes=[];
for(const r of all){if(path.isAbsolute(r.path)||r.path.split(/[\\/]/).includes('..')||r.path.includes(':'))throw Error('Relative proof path required');const a=fs.readFileSync(path.join(work,rel,r.path)),b=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel,r.path));if(a.length!==r.bytes||sha(a)!==r.sha256)throw Error('Donor seal mismatch');if(!a.equals(b)){if(!Buffer.from(a.toString('utf8'),'utf8').equals(a)||!Buffer.from(b.toString('utf8'),'utf8').equals(b)||a.toString('utf8').replaceAll('\r\n','\n')!==b.toString('utf8').replaceAll('\r\n','\n'))throw Error('Non-newline transport difference '+r.path);changes.push({path:r.path,before_bytes:b.length,before_sha256:sha(b),raw:a});}}
for(const c of changes)fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,rel,c.path),c.raw);for(const r of all){const b=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel,r.path));if(b.length!==r.bytes||sha(b)!==r.sha256)throw Error('Final raw mismatch');}
const result={scope:'Git UTF8 newline-only restoration; all differences checked before any writes; no subject rerun',proof:rel,payloads:rows.length,bytes:rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.bytes,0),manifest_sha256:sha(seal),restored:changes.map(({raw,...r})=>({...r,after_bytes:raw.length,after_sha256:sha(raw)})),all_raw_payloads_and_seal_equal_donor:true};fs.writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});console.log(JSON.stringify({proof:rel,payloads:rows.length,bytes:result.bytes,manifest_sha256:result.manifest_sha256,newline_only_restored:changes.length,all_raw_payloads_and_seal_equal_donor:true}));
